# Synthetic upload fixtures

Generated locally with Pillow 12.3.0 from a 32 × 24 RGB arithmetic colour grid; no photographs, third-party data, profiles, EXIF or text metadata. `thumb.jpg` is 16 × 12. All other images are 32 × 24.

JPEG baseline/progressive, RGB PNG, lossy/lossless WebP and alpha WebP exercise the actual encoder output. They are not adversarial structures made to match the validator.

`canvas-chromium.jpg` is the 1800 × 1200 uniform dark image generated by the isolated Chromium canvas fixture on 14-Nov-2026. Its APP2 colour profile reproduces the browser encoder compatibility case. No source photograph or personal metadata is used.
